# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in MusicRemote, please report it responsibly. **Do not** open a public GitHub issue with exploit details.

Instead, please report it privately using [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/saihgupr/musicremote/security/advisories/new) on this repository.

Please include:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept.
- Your environment details (iOS version, jailbreak/injection setup, MusicRemote version).

We will acknowledge your report and work on a fix as soon as possible.
